killedBy: the About & Legal pane in the assembled HUD (issue #117) collapses every document when the pane closes, so a second visit opens on the index
why: Leaves whatever was open still open, so re-entering About & Legal drops the player into the middle of the PolyForm licence rather than onto the index -- and since the pane scrolls from the top, the five toggles are then separated by a document the player did not ask for again. Deliberately hung off `showAbout(false)` rather than off the Back handler, so it covers every route out of the pane; the case that kills this leaves by Back and then re-opens, which is what distinguishes the two placements.
